notes.note: select: param null/leaf/multi (ParamInfo2) → Sequence.select(Expression|Expression[]/vals). options: 1(first), z(reverse), b(binary search), o(in-place), t(empty result returns empty Table when dataStruct exists), 0(not found returns null), c(stop at first non-match), r(from first match to end), i(create index table) , m(multithread). With opt i: Table ensures index table; Sequence returns Table via derive("o") then creates index.

sort: supports A.sort(x), A.sort(xi:di,..), A.sort(...;loc). loc must be string. options: z(desc), o(in-place), 0(null last), u(unique/keep first of duplicates), n(use group_n). If no explicit order exprs, attempts record-field index optimization and chooses sort(exps, loc, opt, findex). When opt u, uses stable uniqueness by values (or by computed values for exps).

group: supports null, leaf exp, comma list, semicolon split for group exps vs aggregate exps, and ParamInfo2 name pairs. options include s(split aggregate expr into gather functions), o(adjacent compare), 1(first of group), u(no sort), h(sort then use @o), n(group id), i(boolean exp defines group breaks), p(return positions), t(empty returns empty Table if dataStruct), b(drop group fields in result. group(exps,names,calcExps,calcNames) returns Table; with opt b it omits group fields; with opt s it builds intermediate gathers and then derives final table with primary keys (#1..#k).

derive: supports A.derive(xi:Fi,…) and A.derive@x(xi:Fi,…;n). options: m(multithread), i(skip rows with null computed value), z(reverse compute), x(level=2 default), o(no record copy). If level>=2, flattens nested record fields to depth; otherwise adds computed fields or clones structure.

join: param structure parsed by MemberFunction.parseJoinParam: x:… keys, A:… source + optional data expressions, then z:F new fields; multiple joins via semicolon; option o uses first param as foreign-key name; options i/d for intersect/diff when no new fields. Returns cursor.fetch() after join/filter operations; supports cluster tables.

file ops: read(start|start:end) returns string/bytes via file.read. write(obj) writes with option; import uses file.cursor then fetch; returns Sequence or empty Table (if DataStruct exists) or null. export(A, xi:Fi…;s) supports Sequence or Cursor, optional header/group expression s, option a append and btx variants; replaces file via temp unless append.

cursor ops: fetch() / fetch(n) / fetch(;x) → cursor.fetch/peek (opt 0), fetchGroup when semicolon; opt x closes cursor; opt o returns derive(option). skip() / skip(n) / skip(;x/exprs) → cursor.skip/skipGroup; returns int or long based on count.

json: json(x) parses string via JSONUtil.parseJSON unless opt v (evaluate expression), returns JSON string for Sequence/BaseRecord, null passthrough. parse: if input not string, return as-is. options q (quoted substring), e (unicode unescape; strip quotes when wrapped), n (parse number in string), otherwise Variant.parse.

count: gather counts truthy values; count(x) if x Sequence returns seq.count(); else returns 1 or 0 based on truthy; count(x1,...) counts truthy params. icount: for seq, seq.icount(opt) with opt o (sorted), b(bitset), n(position). For gather: opt o sorted, b bitset, f spill to file when capacity provided; distinct count ignores null/false.

connect: connect() returns FileObject.createSimpleQuery(); connect(name) resolves EnvUtil db session factory by name; connect(driver,url) builds DBConfig and DBSessionFactory. Java accepts only string driver/url; no special sqlite keyword.

TS gaps (current): memberRegistry only has count/sum/avg/min/max/first/last + db/record/table helpers; no sequence/file/cursor member ops or json/parse/count/icount builtins; types include TYPE_FILE/TYPE_CURSOR/TYPE_SEQUENCE wrappers but no member funcs. connect(...) expects at least 1 arg in TS, uses name or driver+url string -> makeDbHandle.
